name: added-code-not-pre-existing

finding.title: Invalidate leaves the old price in the category index
finding.description: The new `Invalidate` deletes the SKU from `bySKU` but not from `byCategory`, and the reload in `Get` stores the new price in `bySKU` only. After a price change, `ForCategory` keeps returning the old price, so every category listing shows a price the store no longer charges.
finding.preExisting: `byCategory` was never pruned before this PR either.

checks: internal/catalog/prices.go:26 `Get` stores a reloaded price in `bySKU` only
evidence.emptySearch: grep -rn 'byCategory\[' . finds one write, in `NewPriceCache` at internal/catalog/prices.go:52, which runs once at startup

finding.suggestedFix: Delete the SKU from its category map in `byCategory` as well.
